title: Dermal fillers
what: The doctor injects a gel under the skin, usually made of hyaluronic acid. It fills wrinkles or adds volume, for example to the lips or cheeks.
why: To soften deep wrinkles and smile lines, or to shape the lips, cheeks, or chin.
duration: the procedure usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; the effect is seen right away and usually lasts from 6 months to a year or longer
tell_doctor: Cold sores on the lips, even if it was long ago
Blood thinners. Do not stop them on your own. Your doctor will decide
If you had fillers before, where, and when

prepare.title: Before the procedure
prepare.text: If you can, avoid alcohol for a few days before. Ask your doctor about your medicines.

prepare.title: Plans
prepare.text: Swelling and bruises can happen. Do not plan important events for the next few days.

steps: The doctor discusses the result you want
The skin is cleaned, and a numbing cream is often applied
The gel is injected with a thin needle or a flexible cannula
The doctor spreads the gel with a gentle massage
Something cold is applied, and you are told about aftercare
feel: You can feel the injections, but the numbing cream and the numbing medicine in the gel help
Afterward, swelling, and sometimes bruises and firm spots, for a few days
after: Do not touch or massage the area, unless your doctor says so
For a few days, no saunas, steam rooms, tanning beds, or sports
Swelling usually goes down in a few days to two weeks
A follow-up visit, if your doctor books one
red_flags: The skin at the injection site turns white, bluish, or blotchy, with severe pain: see a doctor urgently
Changes in vision after a facial injection: call emergency services
Swelling that keeps getting worse, redness, or a fever

faq.q: Can a filler be removed if I do not like it?
faq.a: A hyaluronic acid gel can usually be dissolved with a special medicine. Your doctor decides.

faq.q: Why are my lips so big after the procedure?
faq.a: In the first days it is swelling. The final shape usually shows after 1 to 2 weeks.

reminders.text: Filler procedure tomorrow. Come without makeup and bring a list of your medicines.
